content.user_title: Test Email Delivery with Mailtrap Sandbox
content.value_statement: Developers need to verify email output without sending messages to real recipients. This skill guides Mailtrap Sandbox setup, inspection, and API-based test workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Mailtrap Email Sandbox instead of live email sending.
Lists sandbox API and SMTP endpoints for sending and reading test messages.
Describes token scope, inbox ID, and account ID requirements for sandbox workflows.
Points users to official SDK repositories and Mailtrap documentation for current options.
Identifies common mistakes when mixing sandbox and transactional email endpoints.
limitations: Does not provide full framework-specific setup guides.
Does not replace official API reference details or SDK README updates.
Does not support production email delivery or live recipient testing.
Requires a valid Mailtrap account, sandbox inbox, and scoped API token.

use_cases.title: Capture Development Email
use_cases.description: Route local or staging messages into a Mailtrap test inbox for safe inspection.

use_cases.title: Automate Email Assertions
use_cases.description: Use Sandbox API concepts to plan CI checks for headers, bodies, attachments, and spam reports.

use_cases.title: Separate Sandbox From Production
use_cases.description: Review endpoints, token scope, and inbox IDs before enabling email in shared environments.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Sandbox SMTP
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for an existing app
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me configure an existing staging app to send mail into Mailtrap Sandbox through SMTP. Include required settings and safety checks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose API Or SMTP
prompt_templates.scenario: Select the right sandbox integration path
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Mailtrap Sandbox API and SMTP for my test workflow. Recommend one option and explain the token, inbox ID, and inspection steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan CI Email Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a CI email testing flow with Mailtrap Sandbox. Cover captured message lookup, assertions, spam checks, and cleanup expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Review Sandbox Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my planned Mailtrap Sandbox integration before release. Check endpoint separation, token scope, inbox ID usage, SDK documentation, and production safety risks.

output_examples.input: I need to test password reset emails from staging without reaching customers.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Mailtrap Sandbox SMTP for the existing staging app and lists checks for host, port, credentials, and inbox capture.

output_examples.input: I want CI to verify that an order receipt email was generated correctly.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines a Sandbox API workflow to find the captured message, inspect headers and body content, and review spam signals.

output_examples.input: I am unsure whether my integration uses live or sandbox Mailtrap endpoints.
output_examples.output: The skill highlights the separate sandbox API and SMTP hosts, then recommends verifying token scope and inbox ID before testing.

best_practices: Use sandbox-specific tokens and credentials for all test environments.
Verify inbox ID and account ID before automating Sandbox API calls.
Check official SDK README files before generating integration code.
anti_patterns: Do not use sandbox endpoints or credentials for production delivery.
Do not reuse production API tokens for sandbox testing.
Do not assume sandbox messages are delivered to real recipients.

faq.question: Does this skill send real email?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Mailtrap Email Sandbox, where messages are captured in test inboxes.

faq.question: Can it help with SMTP testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists sandbox SMTP settings and explains when SMTP is the right option.

faq.question: Can it help with API-based tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It summarizes Sandbox API paths for listing, fetching, and sending test messages.

faq.question: Does it include framework-specific tutorials?
faq.answer: No. It points users to Mailtrap documentation and SDK README files for current framework details.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A valid sandbox token, sandbox credentials, account ID, and inbox ID may be required.

faq.question: Is it useful for production email setup?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly separates sandbox testing from live transactional email sending.
